guidelines: ASTHMA 2024 guideline recommends step-wise treatment based on disease severity and patient phenotype.
For asthma, combination therapy is recommended when monotherapy does not achieve adequate control.
Non-pharmacological measures (lifestyle, diet, exercise) are emphasized as core components of asthma management.
Periodic monitoring and risk stratification are recommended to tailor therapy in asthma patients.
rwe: Real-world evidence shows suboptimal adherence to guideline-directed therapy in asthma, especially in low-resource settings.
Access, affordability, and health literacy remain key barriers for patients living with asthma in emerging markets.
Registry data suggest substantial regional variation in outcomes for asthma, reflecting differences in healthcare infrastructure.
Patient-reported outcomes highlight persistent unmet needs in symptom control and quality of life for asthma patients.
